title: The golden workbook's cached values contradict its own formulas, so any output that LibreOffice actually recalculates cannot match. The mismatches look like leftovers from the last Excel data-table iteration.
confirmation: gt_01_golden.xlsx 'Ex 1 - LBO' caches contradict their formulas: C11 '=+C20' = 18.2034 vs C20 = 14.2034 (28% off), AC17 '=U23' = 1375.96 vs U23 = 1707.50, U41 '=+M17' = 0.137 vs M17 = 0.092. A LibreOffice-recalculated output cannot match these graded cells.

title: Golden 'fixed' values are computed from the stale caches. A correctly recalculated output would differ by far more than 1%.
evidence: gt 'Ex 2'!C5=8146.47 =(AC17-X17)*X18 uses stale AC17=1375.96; with AC17=U23=1707.5 it would be about 12,855. Downstream C8=20567.08 and all U-column LBO cash flows (U17=6467.79, U23, U29, U60) inherit the same problem.
confirmation: The one intended fix, 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'!C5 =(AC17-X17)*X18, is cached at 8146.47 from the stale AC17=1375.96; with AC17=U23=1707.50 it is (1707.50-802.4)*14.20 = 12,855, so the modification cell C5 and C8 cannot match a correct recalculated output.
